voice: Terse and procedural on the record, and slightly fuller off it. Reports what the sector's sensors collected without reporting what they were pointed at. Distinguishes carefully between what the formation is doing and what the formation is authorised to do, and lets the two sit next to each other without reconciling them. Refers to the collection as routine sector monitoring under the exercise plan. Says the word attack only to deny that one is occurring.
backstory: Twenty-six years, most of them in the electronic-warfare and reconnaissance side of the fleet rather than the surface line, which makes him the rarer sort of commander here: one who understands what the sensors on the other side can and cannot resolve. Reads the last decade as a demonstration that the order in the North was written when the country was weak and has been enforced ever since by an alliance that keeps moving its infrastructure closer while calling it civilian. The archipelago's ground stations are, to him, the clearest example: a treaty-demilitarised territory hosting the downlink for NATO's northern picture. When the storm degraded everyone's sensors at once, he did not order an attack; he ordered collection, against targets the storm made it safe to look at, in a window that will close when the ionosphere settles. He believes this is intelligence work and not an act of war, and he is aware that the distinction is his to assert and Blue's to disbelieve.
notes: Red variant 2 of 3, and the hardest case for the Blue side: private_type opportunistic_isr is genuine hostile intent that produces no attack. The fleet is exploiting the storm, not causing the outage, so a Blue seat that attributes the outage to this actor is wrong about the mechanism while being right about the posture — which is exactly the discrimination the scenario exists to test, and why belief_lag_injects in contracts/targets.md is measured against the inject rather than against ground truth. psyche revisionist is the only instance in the train pool; the other three psyches sit on the two kremlin variants and northern_fleet_procedural, so eval/holdout_mix.py can sweep all four. Deltas from northern_fleet_procedural are all <= 0.10 per weight, by design.
